literal: At the appropriate time done help, small even if, than the world greatly greater.
translation: A good deed done at the right time, even if small in measure, is vastly greater than the world.
modern: தக்க காலத்தில் செய்யப்பட்ட உதவி சிறியதாக இருந்தாலும், அது இந்த உலகத்தை விட மிகப் பெரியதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the immense value of timely help. The word 'காலத்தினால்' shows that the worth of a good deed is measured not by its physical size, but by the critical need of the moment. Therefore, even a small act of assistance rendered exactly when needed is considered far greater than the earth itself.
